strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
What the heck? We came inside, but there's nobody here.
Was this place really attacked?
What are you talking about? We barged right in,
and the garrison hasn't come out, has it?
Then the garrison troops are...
There might be survivors. We have to find them, fast...
Wait, Akito! Ruri's scanning for readings inside right now...
Should've checked before we went in.
It may not be active now, but the Gate of Zedan is a space fortress.
Jammers were blocking scans from the outside.
A jammer... to jam us up?
No, that's not it... "Jam" is English for radio interference.
Captain, the anti-scan systems seem to be active inside, too.
It'll take a little more time.
What a drag. Wouldn't it be faster to check it out in the Aestivalis?
Yeah, yeah! Whoever attacked this place ran off when we showed up!
That's rather optimistic... We should make sure the area is secure first.
If we're surrounded inside the fortress, we're in for a hard fight.
Sure, but... isn't finding survivors more important?
Yurika, give me permission to sortie!
Akito... All right. Aestivalis team, launch and search for survivors!
Captain, the area scan is complete. We're completely surrounded.
Oh? Really? Then Akito's team should hurry and... Wait, what!?
Many unregistered robot weapons. They seem to be in attack formation.
Wh-What the!?
What's going on!? Yurika!
Bah! I figured anyone careless enough to wander right inside
would be easy prey...
but deploying your forces at once like that... You're quite cautious!
...Ahaha. O-Of course we are!
But this is perfect. The ones guarding this place
were far too weak to satisfy me! Here I come!
I'll show you the power of Dangel!
Hey, hey... He's getting all worked up by himself.
Just like Yamada!
No way!
I'd never spout cheesy villain lines like that!
True, you don't say villain lines...
Listen, scum... You've had your fun, but now that Gai Daigoji is here,
you won't get your way! Prepare yourself!
Yep, they're two of a kind...
Fwahahaha! How long can you keep running your mouth?
Bow down before the Great Magma!
All forces, attack!
Still... they look pretty strong.
But with such a brutish type in command...
I'm afraid we can't expect to find any survivors...
Dammit... We came to help... Were we too late!?
Retake the Gate of Zedan! Aestivalis team and Nadesico, battle stations!
Even so...
they seem unlike any of the forces Londo Bell has been fighting...
Though they do seem similar to the Vega Star Federation...
Let's do it first and think later.
Whoa!? My Great Magma!? Impossible... This must be a mistake!
Blast it, curses!
Dammit, you're running away!?
So these are the Earthlings Garuda has been struggling with!
Remember this! Next time, I'll finish off every last one of you!
Hah! Don't bother coming back!
Tch... He ran off.
Multiple new readings appearing inside the Gate of Zedan.
What!? There were more hiding?
What the hell are those...? They're nothing like the ones that attacked.
I don't know... They're creepy...
They don't really feel like robots...
A different type from the ones we're fighting now...
Actually, I can't even tell if they're machines or living things.
I don't think we can count on things like that being friendly...
Of course not! Anything shaped like that can't be a hero of justice!
Yeah... For once, I agree with Yamada...
Hm!? ...I see. The Oleana-linked ones Lady Janera spoke of.
Creepy bunch... But if I'm told not to touch them, there's nothing for it.
Hmph, how dull.
Enemy reinforcements identified. They're in Londo Bell's battle logs.
Identity unknown. But they will definitely attack.
Akito, did you hear!? Looks like more enemies showed up. Hang in there!
We'd just about cleared out these robots... and now more unknowns!?
Captain, another reading. A ship's broken in from outside the Gate.
Geez, what is it now?
My, my, visitors galore... Oh? What's that?
Seems we made it in time... Nadesico, Captain Misumaru! Are you all right!?
Captain Bright! ...But how did you get here so fast?
This operation might turn into a fortress assault.
Captain Bright decided we should back up your ship early on.
As expected, Londo Bell's commander is very considerate.
That type is a hit with women his age.
Is that so... I'd better learn from him...
Then again, being too uptight is a turnoff.
That's a harsh opinion. ...Hm, that enemy...!?
...Not... yet...
(Ugh... I can hear it again... Doesn't sound like a whisper of love, though...)
Those guys again? I'm sick of them... Huh, Mia?
That enemy's different from the others... It feels dangerous...
Get a grip! Danger comes with fighting!
The ones the Nadesico is fighting seem different from them, though...
Just blow 'em all away! We can think later!
Those things got in here, too!?
I really can't figure that bunch out!
Anyway, let's go back up everyone on the Nadesico!
All pilots, prepare to launch, on the double!
All right, hang on! I'll scatter 'em in one go...!
Right, you monsters... Now that I'm here, you're done running wild!
Captain, another reading. A ship's broken in from outside the Gate.
Geez, what is it now?
My, my, visitors galore... Oh? What's that?
Hm... We're a bit late, but it seems we still made it in time.
Nadesico, Captain Misumaru! Are you all right!?
Captain Bright! You came for us!
We were delayed dealing with another incident first...
You've done well. We'll back you up at once.
Hmm... He never forgets a kind word, does he?
That type is a hit with women his age.
Is that so... I'd better learn from him...
Then again, being too uptight is a turnoff.
That's a harsh opinion. ...Hm, that enemy...!?
...Not... yet...
(Ugh... I can hear it again... Doesn't sound like a whisper of love, though...)
Those guys again? I'm sick of them... Huh, Mia?
I knew it... That enemy's different from the others... It feels dangerous...
Get a grip! Danger comes with fighting!
They said the ones that attacked here were a type not on record, but...
Either way, just blow 'em all away! We can think later!
Those things got in here, too!?
I really can't figure that bunch out!
Anyway, let's go back up everyone on the Nadesico!
All pilots, prepare to launch, on the double!
All right, hang on! I'll scatter 'em in one go...!
Right, you monsters... Now that I'm here, you're done running wild!
All enemy readings gone.
Looks like we've driven off the enemy occupying the Gate of Zedan.
Finally drove 'em off... Geez... When we got surrounded, I was worried...
...But the garrison troops...
Don't worry. They evacuated early on in escape pods.
Huh? So they'd already run for it?
So we didn't need to come rushing over at all?
Don't say that... Avoiding a hopeless battle is part of a commander's job.
I see... Thank goodness... So the damage was light, right?
Judging from the state of the Gate of Zedan, the ones who attacked
weren't after destruction.
It's safe to say the damage to facilities and personnel was minimal.
So the operation was a huge success!
V for victory!
Ahem... Well, yes. You did well, crew of the Nadesico.
Thank you once again.
Not at all. We owe it all to Londo Bell's support.
Still, those weird enemies... You just can't get a handle on 'em, huh?
Yeah... Unlike the ones that attacked here, they don't occupy places,
and it's not clear they're after Earth, either...
But it bothers me... I can't read the intent of those later arrivals at all...
We can't figure out any clear goal at all...
Like Ruri said, their very composition
makes them hard to identify...
Not being able to explain them at all... This is a grave matter...
If the ones occupying the Gate of Zedan weren't out to destroy it,
they probably meant to use it as a base.
So they're like the Vega Star Federation... out to invade Earth?
Geez, they just keep coming one after another...
Is Earth really that interesting a place!?
Few civilizations have this much variety in robot tech and energy,
I'd think.
Still, the enemies just keep multiplying.
And the Gaizok don't seem to have learned their lesson either.
Tons of enemy forces, all with different aims... What a pain.
Hm? What's wrong?
Huh? Oh, it's nothing. Just grown-up stuff.
(I heard it again... What is it...?)
All right, we head for our next destination.
Roger! Please hurry and recover the Aestivalis team.
